items.event: DP World Tour Championship, Dubai (Race to Dubai finale)
items.line: Eugenio Chacarra, a three-time winner this season, leads the Race to Dubai by 534 points over Rory McIlroy, who is chasing a record-equalling eighth title. Patrick Reed and Jon Rahm are among the nine players who can still win the Race. The winner gets 2,000 points, and there's no cut.
items.whenJst: Thu Nov 12 – Sun Nov 15 · rounds start ~13:00 JST (approx.)

items.event: Nations League: Spain v England, Madrid
items.line: The League A Group 3 finale at the Metropolitano. Spain (12 pts) beat England 3-2 in September, and England (9 pts) must first face Croatia on Thursday (Fri 04:45 JST). Top spot in the group is at stake before March's knockout rounds.
